nom: StriVectin Intensive Eye Concentrate For Wrinkles PLUS

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who says nearly every eye product burns her, report this cream is uniquely non-irritating and effective; the one caution comes from a reviewer who advises sensitive-skin users to be careful, since she noticed some slight peeling when combined with her other skincare.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal, with only slight, lifelong under-eye circles and little puffiness, found it adequately moisturizing but no better than her regular face cream.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s through 80s are overwhelmingly positive, many crediting years of consistent use with fewer wrinkles, less puffiness, and compliments on how young they look; dissent comes specifically from two reviewers in their late 40s and early 50s who saw no improvement in their fine lines or crow's feet after weeks of consistent use.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers, especially those over 50, report visibly softer fine lines, crow's feet, and frown lines between the brows, some within a week and many after years of consistent use; a real minority dissent, several in their late 40s to early 50s reporting no improvement at all even after weeks or months of twice-daily use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the cream as effectively hydrating and moisturizing the under-eye area; the mildest dissent comes from one reviewer who found it adequately moisturizing but no better than her regular face cream.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including several who describe themselves as highly sensitive or an eye-cream connoisseur who reacts to most products, report zero irritation even with long-term or twice-daily use; against that, a notable cluster of reviewers report burning, stinging, peeling, itching, or swelling severe enough to stop using it, and one reports her eyes swelled enough overnight to create new wrinkles that were not there before.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report their dark circles fading or looking less prominent, in some cases within a week, though several describe it as a partial improvement rather than a full disappearance; dissent comes from a couple of reviewers who report their dark circles and lines are unchanged even after a proper length of trial.
concerns.blemishes: The one reviewer who addresses this directly says the cream does not cause the milia bumps that many other eye creams give her.

aspects.libelle: Subtle tint that blends under-eye skin tone

extraits.texte: It is the worst product I have ever bought. It caused a lot of damage around my eyes and it never stopped peeling and itching . I claimed many times but Strivectin does not care about the clients, they only care about taking their money.

Based on the wordage, cult favorite, #1 wrinkle smoothing eye cream...I decided to try it. I am 51 with fine lines and crow's feet. This product says it addresses those concerns; I applied am and pm for weeks with no results. I gave up and am now trying the Retinol eye cream. Hopefully, I will see results with that eye cream.

I put it on after cleaning my face before I went to sleep and I woke up with swollen eyes. I also woke up with wrinkles due to my swollen eyes and I've never had wrinkles there before. I am 28, it just didn't work for me.

I'm a normal skinned person who has had slight under eye circles my whole life, little puffiness and no creasing (yet). It was fine at moisturizing but nothing my face cream can't do already. I prefer a cold roller eye cream dispenser for eye products.

I have very sensitive eyes. The skin around my eyes is super sensitive almost everything burns. However this eye cream does not burn my eyes or my skin. Very nice consistency not greasy at all and moisturizing. I would repurchase again.

extraits.titre: Intense eye concentrate for wrinkles plus
extraits.texte: Added this product to my Strivectin collection because of the amazing results from other products. In less than a week my crows feet are barely noticeable. The horrible puffy bags under my eyes are finally not visible like they were and are diminishing more and more daily. The dark circles are fading as well more and more daily. I'm extremely happy (let me re-phrase that) beyond surprisingly happy with this product! I use the Peptide 360 tightening eye serum first let it soak in then apply this. Not sure I really need both but with the amazing results I'm using both and will not ever go without these two products. This is the first product that I've used for my nasty looking puffy under eye bags and dark circles that has worked. I sure with I'd of found this many many products ago and lots of money ago that I've spent to get no results. I know for a fact the longer I use this, I will end up with no more bags or dark circles. My eyes do not look tired and dull anymore already. They look brighter and refreshed. You can not go wrong with this!!!!

extraits.titre: It works...and I've tried them all!
extraits.texte: I'm basically an eye cream junkie. The issue is that I have the most sensitive skin in existence so I literally try all of them and the ones that tend to show results are usually the most irritating. This eye cream is the best I've tried yet. You will see line softening results with continued use but the best part is zero irritation. No irritation means I can actually use the product long enough to get results! I luckily don't have crows feet yet but at 39 my undereyes really needed help and everyday I wake up this cream is making them look better and better!
